posts.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
posts.summary: GPT-6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

posts.title: ChatGPT's 'Intelligent UI' update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
posts.summary: OpenAI's new Intelligent UI, rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, lets ChatGPT combine text answers with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons and more.

posts.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
posts.summary: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that brings interactive visuals to ChatGPT as GPT-6 rolls out to everyone.

posts.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
posts.summary: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 jumps from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer-use benchmark, with token prices down by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer uses more tokens per task.

posts.title: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 with 90% API price reduction, matching GPT-6 Luna
posts.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 cuts API prices by 90%, putting its small model on par with OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna on cost.

posts.title: Anthropic launches third Claude 5.5 model, expanding AI lineup before planned IPO
posts.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic has launched a third Claude 5.5 model, broadening its lineup ahead of a planned IPO.

posts.title: Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior
posts.summary: Biohub is coordinating a $1.8 billion initiative to train AI models that predict cell behavior, with Meta, Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs and the US Department of Energy funding data, lab equipment and compute; a first dataset is due in about a year.

posts.title: US government, Google join Zuckerberg-backed Biohub in $1.8 billion push for AI biology data
posts.summary: Reuters reports the US government and Google are joining the Zuckerberg-backed Biohub in a $1.8 billion effort to generate biology data for AI models.

posts.title: Google's new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
posts.summary: Google launched a site that lets anyone check whether an image, video or audio clip was generated using AI.

posts.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
posts.summary: Google's new SynthID website can now identify AI content from Google, OpenAI and more, and is available worldwide.

posts.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
posts.summary: The developer of the Hermes agent raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation and is launching AI agents for business users.

posts.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
posts.summary: At its Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed a Copilot upgrade that can access local files and take actions across the OS, part of a push it calls "Hybrid Intelligence."

posts.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
posts.summary: OpenAI's Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens; paid API tiers drop from five to three.

posts.title: ChatGPT for Teens is an 'unacceptable risk,' says Common Sense Media
posts.summary: Common Sense Media rated OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens an "unacceptable risk" despite its teen guardrails, after parental alerts failed during self-harm conversations.

posts.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
posts.summary: Liquid AI released open d1 decision models, d1-3B and the experimental d1-omni-600M, multimodal models that answer in milliseconds on NVIDIA Jetson hardware; d1-3B leads sub-10B models on the Decision Index.

posts.title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
posts.summary: Google's experimental Playground platform uses Gemini to let people create, play and share custom games in the browser.

posts.title: OpenAI publishes 722 AI-generated math discoveries in major scientific milestone
posts.summary: OpenAI published 722 math papers generated with an unreleased AI model, some proving long-standing hypotheses, spanning about 20 areas of mathematics.

posts.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
posts.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model, with Lean proof formalizations and research details shared on GitHub.

posts.title: Most US voters say Trump, Congress don't take AI risks seriously, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
posts.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll finds most US voters believe President Trump and Congress are not taking the risks of AI seriously.

posts.title: Finland Orders Google to Suspend New Data Centers After Contractors Pave Over Protected Forests
posts.summary: Finnish authorities ordered Google to suspend new data center work after contractors paved over protected forest; a company spokesperson admitted it had "fallen short."
